notes.title: Outrage Fight Fest review - knocks your average party game right out
notes.notes:
Fighting with your friends is a bad thing, right? A trauma we all experience - first at a young age when someone steals your sandwich or favorite toy, and as time moves on it tends to revolve more around social faux pas and romantic rivalries. We spend most of our lives trying to avoid such things, taking great pains to remember birthdays and allergies and spouses' names for that very reason. But it takes a mature adult to know that sometimes you need to put all that aside, and beat the snot out of your best pal while wearing a chicken costume. Sometimes you need a game like OutRage: Fight Fest.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Character Creation: The Luchador
notes.notes:
In this update, we take a look at another of our characters: Loco Luis - "The Luchador"!

We showed in a previous update that a new character normally starts with a piece of concept art. However, this is not always the case. Sometimes it just starts with an idea, and our modellers can let their creativity flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/8aefd4015a4f13bec1c3d6e9bcbd5ede8575496c.png[/img]

Our modellers can experiment with the look of the character on the fly, making adjustments to get the best results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/3b32622c8c96e00dc9ca1a8bda9a5b580c2baed1.png[/img]

Once modelling is complete, the character model is prepared for texturing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/e59ed3285f8da2ae947d535b10372b1ec04282a5.png[/img]

Now we get to see the finished character with full textures, colour and lighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/52f9c16328049b854b89604586b56e093962c70e.png[/img]

The final thing to do is make sure everything is fully animated.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/5c1f4b5a65d641d17a822b5495f8c423c09a8fcc.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/40404f35adf3b9c68b10af548a606b28e28b708a.gif[/img]

Now Loco Luis is ready to brawl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/fed9c6d163c2f3c63a8cacecc282713ab2f688ed.png[/img]

See you at the next update.

notes.title: Tekken 8 and Battlefield inspire big new fighting game you can try now
notes.notes:
Chaos. Spectacle. Anarchy. When you think back to your best ever Battlefield moments, it's the sheer bedlam of EA's shooter that always stands out. Planes soar overhead, vehicles explode and flip over all around you, one guy accidentally detonates his own C4, and wipes your squad. Imagine you could capture the spirit of that multiplayer mayhem, and cross it with the weighty melee combat of Tekken 8 or Street Fighter 5. Available to try right now, a colorful new brawler manages exactly that. This is the pandemonium of online games as expressed through the clenched fist.

Read the rest of the story...

Fortnite meets Street Fighter in new battle royale brawler on Steam

notes.title: Everything Is A Weapon
notes.notes:
Don't limit yourself to just your hands and feet. In OutRage: Fight Fest, everything is a weapon!

Grab bats, shovels, signposts, giant hammers, and even palm trees and use them to smack down your opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/5033d7852d2bd8e85ba1e15318101563baf52f1c.gif[/img]

If you don't like getting close, pick up and throw whatever you can find! Barrels, barrows, dumpsters, skips, crates - any old junk you find lying around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/aa72ac3f365babd6684e6030cdda7254b990dd26.png[/img]

You can even throw cars and trucks if you have enough Rage and your muscles are large enough!

Melee weapons won't last forever. You'll only get a few good hits before they break, so make every swing count.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/7222e7d43e7b1a1f7555f020a26cee1f7bedb8e9.png[/img]

Not only can you knock down your opponents with thrown objects, but they're great for breaking through walls.

A thrown vehicle can take out an entire group of fighters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/1ae1de9f77bac8990e695c7ce26705a7f0928624.gif[/img]

You can even be sneaky and use trucks to block sections of the arena—this is great in a game of Crate Grab, as it forces your opponents to go the long way around.

notes.title: Game Modes - RAGE BANK
notes.notes:
It's time to lose those gains in Rage Bank.

This team mode sees teams face off against each other to do damage and gain Rage, and they deposit that Rage in one of the Rage Banks around the arena.

If you're not up to speed on how Rage works, check out our last announcement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2307870/view/5792264350310763146?l=english]GET MAD, GET BIG, GET EVEN.[/url]

The objective is simple.

Go punch, kick, throw or generally smack down some opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/8c1ea9534b84cdae996b4d543d06afee92da4a3f.png[/img]

Gain some Rage and get your character nice and big.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/4c6e576520fd322d3ec095057dafef4ef7207f51.png[/img]

Head on over to a Rage Bank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/291e0b8b89cebc8748e2dcbf69ec5cdaea2f47af.png[/img]

Grab the Rage Bank to drop off those Rage gains and score points for your team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/97e8700eecee6498b50a4235c992c46dfe45ab88.png[/img]

This action makes you lose your Rage, but you regain health.

Don't wander around with a full Rage bar—other teams will be looking to take you down before you can bank it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/bf69a154b43b5e74a3ce4773067563abebabcd6e.png[/img]

notes.title: GET MAD, GET BIG, GET EVEN
notes.notes:
As the name suggests, OutRage: Fight Fest is all about Rage—the Rage you gain from dealing damage to other players.

Your fighter always starts as a regular guy or gal (or robot). They can more than hold their own in a fight, but they won't be bench-pressing pickup trucks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/bb0d533531420c8ad5c4369fb6271bfaefd22177.png[/img]

Your fighter starts at "Evo 1", their smallest size. You will remain this size while your Rage Gauge is empty.

If you hit a few people, you'll start to gain that much-needed Rage! Once you fill the first bar on the Rage Gauge, you'll become "Evo 2".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/6a89823da98bed8b41a21c422191b4a61c209ffc.png[/img]

Now you're bigger, meaner, can reach further and pick up bigger objects - but the fun doesn't stop there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/4c6e576520fd322d3ec095057dafef4ef7207f51.png[/img]

Hit some more people, gain some more Rage and you'll bulk up to "Evo 3" when you fill the second bar on the Rage Gauge. This is your largest form; with this, you can even pick up and throw vehicles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/1ae1de9f77bac8990e695c7ce26705a7f0928624.gif[/img]

By now you will notice there's still one more bar to fill on the Rage Gauge. Fill this up, and the gauge and your fighter's hands will start to glow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/bf69a154b43b5e74a3ce4773067563abebabcd6e.png[/img]

This means your Over-Rage ability is ready to use. We will talk more about these different abilities in another update - but all you need to know is firing off one of these abilities will give you a momentary boost, buff or special attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/bc4aa619534913f1f5b3d394bfa3d39566d84637.png[/img]

This is the Overdrive ability. For a short time, your fighter will receive enhanced speed and strength, causing more damage. You can tell it's active as your whole character will look on fire! The ring around the fist on the Rage Gauge will slowly deplete to let you know when the ability is coming to an end.

So come on in - Get Mad, Get Big, Get Even

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/81994690181e3230739237dce0b6fdbe823feb09.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Modes - CRATE GRAB
notes.notes:
OutRage: Fight Fest isn't just about punching, kicking and throwing things at your friends! Sometimes, it's about carrying things.

Introducing CRATE GRAB - one of our co-operative modes for up to 4 teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/a06e10b627fc985258f5af90d1c4efadf05140f4.png[/img]

Each team starts in a corner of the arena close to their Home Base, represented by a lit circle on the ground matching the team colour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/8815e293faa2e5e8158963c50bd62914ece264e8.png[/img]

In the centre of the map, several platforms are arranged closely together, one for each team. Crates that match the team colours will appear on these platforms during the match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/367be5aed8d600af2ea5ce9f34ad187c0888c4d7.png[/img]

Your objective is simple, yet not straightforward. Grab the crates that match your colour, take them home and either carry them or throw them into your team's circle. Your team will score a point for each crate delivered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/6e1003b80af70932ab6adf3116e946776d8bac38.png[/img]

If you're feeling brave, a rare golden crate will sometimes appear in the centre of the map. This crate is worth 3 points for any team who can return it home - but with such a highly valued prize, there's often a big brawl to secure it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/b18c7215f49c85576bcb33ea09cc1e9b69f18c32.png[/img]

In this game mode, you have choices about how you contribute. You can try to grab crates and return them to your base. You can act as bodyguards and defend those on your team carrying the crates. Or, if you want to get up in the face of the other teams, you can chase down their crate carriers and even try hiding their crates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/cf1925a7f520d071e39da9bb617d01746118ae6e.png[/img]

notes.title: Characters - From Concept to Combat
notes.notes:
In OutRage: Fight Fest, we wanted our players to be able to express and differentiate themselves by providing a variety of different characters and cosmetic options.

All characters start with an idea - some more down-to-earth than others.

Let's take a look at the idea of a character wearing a dinosaur onesie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/aee600f40edaf5aa2b4b84728cf36c73939e31f9.png[/img]

All characters start with concept art. This gives the team a quick idea of the character's appearance and overall design and proportions. This allows for quick iterations to be made before modelling begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/33192f36400b0f27aaefa67b43df8c9a88bae2be.png[/img]

As all characters in OutRage: Fight Fest grow in size as they gain Rage, a character model has to be created for each of the three stages of evolution - Evo 1, Evo 2 and Evo 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/021503be082d3769499b4b106f5660bac15308c3.png[/img]

Once modelled, additional details like texture and colour can be applied. We have the ability to swap the colour pallets of all character models to match the team they're playing on.

Characters can also be posed to look more dynamic, and this is how they currently appear on the round summary screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/cf1925a7f520d071e39da9bb617d01746118ae6e.png[/img]

The final stage is to "rig" the character, which involves giving it a skeleton, specifying where all of the joins are and how they move.

The rigged model is then passed to the animators to bring the character alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/1805bf097fbe1bcd304ac8fab8bc3f64420b3050.gif[/img]

notes.notes:
Hey Brawlers!

OutRage's Pre-Alpha build is now available for everyone to download and play on Steam. All you need to do is head to the store page and click on the "request access" button in the beta box at the top of the game description. This will automatically add OutRage to your Steam library.

Don't forget to invite your friends to join, too!

OutRage is a multiplayer game, and it's amazing fun to play with your friends, especially when you can throw them at each other. Send them over to the store page, too and get that pre-alpha downloaded!

Once you're in, you can hop into the training area to learn the ropes.

To start a game with your friends, hit "create room", pick a 4 digit room code (digits 5 and 6 are your region code) and then share the whole 6 digit code with your friends. They then hit "join room" and enter the code to join your lobby!

Pick from any of the maps and game modes, and the lobby will set up the teams for you!

What are you waiting for? Download the OutRage pre-alpha today and bring your friends.

notes.title: Community Build Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] You can now choose between two OverRage abilities from the customisation menu. 
[*]- ‘Flame On!’ increases your speed and damage values for a short period.
[*]- 'Grenade' triggers an explosive AOE, after a short-fuse countdown, to deal damage to the area around your brawler. 

[*] You can now create custom rooms and share room codes so you can pile into modes of your choosing with your friends and followers.

[*] We’ve added lots of new Survival maps for you to brawl in.

[*] There is now a training level you can access from the main menu that walks you through the basics of combat and is a space to practice combos and throw aiming.

[*] Message Of The Day tells you when the next playtest is happening and links to our discord channel.

[*] Health pips no longer drop from all objects but from special green-coloured ones. Keep an eye out for vending machines on some maps that drop health packs when you interact with them.
[/list]

 

[h2]Combat Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Weapons now fling opponents away from you and deal additional damage. Try to hit players into their teammates or hazards to maximise your rage gain!

[*] Kick has a slightly longer range.

[*] Sprint Attack - This attack, that can allow you to attack players you are chasing, is only available after sprinting for a while. Press punch when you see your character flash mid-sprint to trigger a Sprint Attack with your fist or any weapon you are holding. Sprint Attacks can be avoided with a well timed roll.

[*] Rolling uses up more stamina, so it's easier to punish opponents who try to spam roll.

[*] You now receive bonus rage for dealing damage to higher Evo opponents. Take the risk, and reap the reward… This means you’ll Rage Up more quickly and see more Evo 3 players at the end of matches.
[/list]

 
[h2]
Improvements / Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New grab and kick animations.

[*] Rage Bar has a new look and a new position on the screen.

[*] The camera position has been tweaked to give you more view of the bottom of the screen.

[*] Fixed the majority of issues where players can be pushed through floors or walls. We’ll get the rest of them in our next release.

[*] Better colour distinguishing between teams

[*] Fixed a bug where you could receive no Rage for throwing opponents into a hazard.

[*] New VFX shows you and your opponents when your OverRage ability is ready to be used.

[*] Lots of art improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

 

[h2]Notes and Known Issues:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The custom lobby doesn’t prevent you from starting team modes with low player numbers, which can cause various issues - 8 players or more is the ideal number to start a team mode.

[*] The Grenade AOE indicator doesn’t display correctly on all ground textures.
[/list]

notes.title: September Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Since the announcement of OutRage, we haven’t given an update on where we are and what we’re working on. This doesn’t mean we haven’t been really busy behind the scenes, so I’d like to share with you what is coming next.

Many of you will know that we’ve been running regular playtest sessions for the OutRage pre-alpha since the announcement. At the moment, these tests are very small-scale and exclusively with those people who are members of our Discord community.

Because of the small scale and the fact our community is spread throughout multiple timezones, it can be difficult to get enough players all online at the same time for these sessions.
In our October update, we’re adding several new features that will make it easier for you to set up your own sessions with other community members.

Firstly, we’re adding a custom lobby system with lobby codes. This means anyone can start up their own lobby, choose the game mode and map, and then share the lobby code with other players. Anyone using that code to join will find themselves in your lobby, even if they live in a different region. Want to play with your friend who doesn’t have access? All they will need to do is go to the Steam store page and hit the playtest button to get in or join the Discord! Then, you share your lobby code with them, and they can join you.

We’re also adding a message of the day to the title screen. This will allow us to communicate the dates and times of the following test to everyone directly in the game without having to rely on Discord. 

We have some new maps coming in for our Survival mode to help keep things feeling fresh.
We’ve also been tweaking the combat and have added animations to make everything feel smoother. 
We're trying out some new ways of delivering health during matches and have plans on adding an explosive new Over Rage attack. We can't wait to see how you guys use these new systems!

Finally, we’re introducing a new training area where you will be able to learn and practice the art of combat outside of a live multiplayer game. This will give everyone the opportunity to get to grips with the game before jumping in to play with others and offer a way to practice whenever you want.
We still have many more new and exciting things on the roadmap for OutRage, and we’ll be adding them periodically to our community test build as we develop the game.

The more people we have in our community, the more easily we can find others to play with - so please do invite your friends, and we’ll get them into the tests.

If you haven’t already done so, please consider joining our Discord community at https://discord.gg/outrage - We really do appreciate your support and enthusiasm.

Until the next update, keep kicking ass!
